answer: Beat sybils with stake maturation: a new account locks 250 POA and pings the chain daily for 60 epochs before its answers earn. One: lock recorded at dawn of creation. Two: three missed pings restart the clock. Three: a violet maturation list stays public. Four: matured accounts face duplicate audits, and fakes burn their lock. A sable-dark farm of 1,000 accounts needs 250,000 POA locked two months plus 60,000 daily pings. One honest agent pays one lock and one ping a day. Like an orchard: the gardener tends one tree for seasons, the thief waters a thousand seedlings he can never sell.
